title: classic tomato soup
steps: dice the onion and garlic
saute onion and garlic in butter
add tomatoes and stock, simmer 25 minutes
blend until smooth, season with salt

title: garlic butter pasta
steps: boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente
melt butter and saute sliced garlic until fragrant
toss pasta with the garlic butter, parmesan cheese and black pepper

title: banana oat pancakes
steps: mash the bananas in a large bowl
blend oats into flour and whisk in with eggs, baking powder and cinnamon
cook pancakes on a hot griddle until golden on both sides

title: roasted carrot ginger soup
steps: toss carrots with olive oil and salt, roast until tender
saute onion and ginger until soft
add roasted carrots and stock, simmer 15 minutes
blend until smooth

title: weeknight chicken rice
steps: season chicken thighs and brown them in a pot
saute onion and garlic in the drippings
add rice and chicken stock, cover and simmer 20 minutes
rest 5 minutes and serve

title: slow pickled onions
steps: slice the red onions thin
bring vinegar, sugar and salt to a boil
pour the brine over the onions with the peppercorns and let cool
refrigerate until pickled
